title: Grateful Dead Live at Oakland Auditorium on 1982-12-30
lineage: Cassette Master (Sony TC-WE475) -> Sony R500 (Pass Through) -> SEK'D Prodif Plus -> Samplitude Professional v8.01 -> FLAC
taper: Cassettes provided by Joani Walker and Paul Scotton

ai_review.summary: Clean soundboard/matrix capture of a standout late‑'82 show highlighted by a soaring Franklin’s Tower and fresh Fall ’82 material.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its energy, with Jerry and Brent trading gleeful licks on an inspired Franklin’s Tower and the band showcasing new fall‑’82 songs like Dupree's Diamond Blues and Throwing Stones. Reviewers note a clean, well‑transferred recording that lets the music shine, despite one critic finding “Hard to Handle” out of place.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4–5 stars and highlight strong playing and a clean transfer; only one review calls out a single song as weak, so the combined show (70%) and recording (30%) rating is high.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Charlie’s transfer described as clean and perfect; overall crisp sound despite being a matrix capture.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Unusual but engaging set list with unique song combinations and fresh fall‑'82 material; the flow keeps high momentum throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Extending gleeful licks on Franklin's Tower; praised for tone and improvisational flair.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent adds sparkling keyboard lines alongside Jerry’s guitar during Franklin's Tower.
